answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 580 fakes pays 386 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. A jetty that can be verified, a relic that can be measured, and a beacon that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
